# Problem 1

> In the example above, we deep dived the APC-Fire 810 single-color control. Since this is just one of the 29-single colors in the panel, check the pData, identify a fluorophore and marker of interest and repeat the process detailed above for your selected fluorophore. Report whether your chosen fluorophore behaved similarly or otherwise in terms of fluorescent signature variants as was the case for APC-Fire 810.

## Load data

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(data_path, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)
fcs_files
```

```{r}
Bead_FCS <- fcs_files[stringr::str_detect(fcs_files, "Bead")]
Bead_FCS
```

```{r}
Cell_FCS <- fcs_files[stringr::str_detect(fcs_files, "Cells")]
Cell_FCS
```


```{r}
UnstainedCell_FCS <- fcs_files[stringr::str_detect(fcs_files, "_Unstained")]
UnstainedCell_FCS
```

Read samples.

```{r}
Beads_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(Bead_FCS, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
BeadsSC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(Beads_cytoset)

Cells_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(Cell_FCS, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
CellsSC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(Cells_cytoset)

UnstainedCells_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(UnstainedCell_FCS, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
CellsUnstained_GatingSet <- GatingSet(UnstainedCells_cytoset)
```

## Transform data

```{r}
# Identify biexponential fluorescent detectors, exclude linear ones like FSC

SFC_Parameters <- colnames(CellsUnstained_GatingSet)
FluorophoresOnly <- SFC_Parameters[!stringr::str_detect(SFC_Parameters, "FSC|SSC|Time")]

# Biexponential values that were optimal for this particular instrument/dataset, yours may vary, see Week 7!

Biexponential <-  flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
  pos=5.62, neg=0, widthBasis=-1000)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresOnly, Biexponential)
```

Do the transform.

```{r}
# Beads Single Colors

transform(BeadsSC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```

```{r}
# Cells Single Colors

transform(CellsSC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)

# Cells Unstained

transform(CellsUnstained_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```

## Automated gating

```{r}
BeadGatingTable <- tibble::tribble(
  ~filterId,    ~dims,                          ~subset,  
  "scatter",    list("FSC-A", "SSC-A"),      "root",     
  "singlets",   list("FSC-A", "FSC-H"),          "scatter"
)


CellGatingTable <- tibble::tribble(
  ~filterId,    ~dims,                          ~subset,      
  "singlets",   list("FSC-A", "FSC-H"),          "root",  
  "scatter",    list("FSC-A", "SSC-A"),      "singlets",  
)
```



```{r}
# This version prints the index of specimen, so it is easier to follow
# where we are going.
gs_apply_gate_check2 <- function (gs, gate, sample = NULL, AdjustAll = FALSE, ...) 
{
    if (methods::is(gs, "GatingSet")) {
        if (is.null(sample)) {
            Samples <- seq_along(gs)
        }
        else {
            Samples <- sample
        }
        n <- length(Samples)                                 # MODIFIED LINE
        purrr::walk(.x = Samples, .f = function(sample) {
            cat(sprintf("Specimen %i/%i\n", sample, n))      # MODIFIED LINE
            gs_gate_interactive_adjust(gs = gs, gate = gate, 
                sample = sample, AdjustAll = AdjustAll, ...)
        })
    }
    else {
        stop("'gs' must be a GatingSet")
    }
}
```

### Beads

Save the result so this can be knitted. For some reason my GatingSet files got corrupted, so
I added the backend_opt = "copy" option, even though it should be on by default.

```{r}
filename <- file.path(result_path, "BeadsSC_GatingSet.gs")
if (! file.exists(filename) || recompute) {
    flowGate::gs_apply_gating_strategy(BeadsSC_GatingSet, gating_strategy = BeadGatingTable)

    gs_apply_gate_check2(gs=BeadsSC_GatingSet, gate="scatter")
    gs_apply_gate_check2(gs=BeadsSC_GatingSet, gate="singlets")

    save_gs(BeadsSC_GatingSet, filename, backend_opt = "copy")
} else {
    BeadsSC_GatingSet <- load_gs(filename)
}
```

## Update metadata

### Beads

```{r}
bead_pd <- pData(BeadsSC_GatingSet)

Updated_bead_pd <- bead_pd |> mutate(
    raw = str_extract(name, "(?<=DR_)[^(]+(?=\\()"), 
    Antigen = raw |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_extract("^\\S+"), 
    Fluorophore = raw |>
      str_trim() |>
      str_remove("^\\S+\\s+"), 
    Type = name |>
      str_extract("(?<=\\()([^)]+)(?=\\))"),
    raw = NULL
  )

Updated_bead_pd <- Updated_bead_pd |> relocate(Fluorophore, Antigen, Type, .after="name")
```

```{r}
Updated_bead_pd <- Updated_bead_pd |> 
  mutate(Fluorophore = case_when(
    Fluorophore == "PE-Vio770" ~ "PE-Vio 770",
    Fluorophore == "PE-Dazzle594" ~ "PE-Dazzle 594",
    TRUE ~ Fluorophore
  ))
```

```{r}
Updated_bead_pd <- Updated_bead_pd |> mutate(
    Antigen = case_when(
      str_detect(name, "BeadsUnstained") ~ NA_character_,
      .default = Antigen
    ),
    
    Fluorophore = case_when(
      str_detect(name, "BeadsUnstained") ~ "BeadUnstained",
      .default = Fluorophore
    )
  )
```

```{r}
pData(BeadsSC_GatingSet) <- Updated_bead_pd
pData(BeadsSC_GatingSet)
```

```{r}
filename <- file.path(result_path, "UpdatedBeadMetadata.csv")
write.csv(Updated_bead_pd, filename, row.names=FALSE)
```

# Problem 3

> An important part of retrieving the fluorescent signature is to subtract the background autofluorescence. This could vary based on donor, cell type or treatment condition. With the tools provided in this walkthrough, compare the autofluorescent signatures for the 3 cell unstained controls, and whether their use as background would have affected the overall APC-Fire 810 extracted signature or not.

Form external negative based on each unstained sample.

## Negative signatures

```{r}
get_external_negative_signature <- function(gs) {
  ExternalNegativeCytoSet <- gs_pop_get_data(gs[1], "scatter", inverse.transform=TRUE)
  ExternalNegativeData <- exprs(ExternalNegativeCytoSet[[1]]) %>% #[[1]] used to remove list item, allowing access
    data.frame(check.names=FALSE)
  ExternalNegativeSignature <- ExternalNegativeData %>%
    select(!matches("FSC|SSC|Time")) |> 
    summarize_all("median")
}
ExternalNegativeSignature1 <- get_external_negative_signature(CellsUnstained_GatingSet[1])
ExternalNegativeSignature2 <- get_external_negative_signature(CellsUnstained_GatingSet[2])
ExternalNegativeSignature3 <- get_external_negative_signature(CellsUnstained_GatingSet[3])
ExternalNegativePlotData1 <- ExternalNegativeSignature1 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="ExternalBackground1", .before=1)
ExternalNegativePlotData2 <- ExternalNegativeSignature2 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="ExternalBackground2", .before=1)
ExternalNegativePlotData3 <- ExternalNegativeSignature3 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="ExternalBackground3", .before=1)
```

Compare the signatures.

```{r}
CombinedAutofluorescences <- bind_rows(
  ExternalNegativePlotData1,
  ExternalNegativePlotData2,
  ExternalNegativePlotData3)

Plots <- VisualizeSignatures(data=CombinedAutofluorescences,
 columnname="Fluorophore", Normalize = FALSE)

plotly::ggplotly(Plots)
```

Normalised version.

```{r}
Plots <- VisualizeSignatures(data=CombinedAutofluorescences,
 columnname="Fluorophore", Normalize = TRUE)

plotly::ggplotly(Plots)
```

The three unstained samples seem to have quite similar autofluorescences.

## Remove background


```{r}
JustTheFluorophore1 <- PositiveSignature - ExternalNegativeSignature1
JustTheFluorophore2 <- PositiveSignature - ExternalNegativeSignature2
JustTheFluorophore3 <- PositiveSignature - ExternalNegativeSignature3
JustTheFluorophorePlot1 <- JustTheFluorophore1 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="APCFire810_1", .before=1)
JustTheFluorophorePlot2 <- JustTheFluorophore2 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="APCFire810_2", .before=1)
JustTheFluorophorePlot3 <- JustTheFluorophore3 |>
   mutate(Fluorophore="APCFire810_3", .before=1)


JustTheFluorophorePlot <- bind_rows(
  JustTheFluorophorePlot1,
  JustTheFluorophorePlot2,
  JustTheFluorophorePlot3)

Plots <- VisualizeSignatures(data=JustTheFluorophorePlot,
 columnname="Fluorophore", Normalize = FALSE)

plotly::ggplotly(Plots)
```

Normalize.


```{r}
Plots <- VisualizeSignatures(data=JustTheFluorophorePlot,
 columnname="Fluorophore", Normalize = TRUE)

plotly::ggplotly(Plots)
```

No difference in the subtracted signal no matter which of the background samples are used.
